Each of the six equilateral triangles that make up a regular hexagon has a side equal to the hexagon's side. Its perimeter is 21 inches, so each side is 21 ÷ 3 = 7 inches. The hexagon's perimeter is then 6 × 7 = 42 inches.

Solution A wrongly assumes the triangle's side is x/2, which gives 84. Solution B is correct.

WINNER: B
